# Klar Details

> Klar Details is a premium car detailing centre at 48 Toh Guan Road East, #02-124, Enterprise Hub, Singapore 608586 (Jurong East, West Singapore), operating since 2014 and part of MK Group since 1 November 2024. Services: KlarCOAT Signature Ceramic coating, KlarGRAPHENE graphene coating, paint correction, KlarINTERIOR interior detailing with NEA-approved anti-bacterial fumigation, KlarMAINTENANCE half-yearly coating maintenance, new car and EV protection, premium hand wash. Over 2,500 cars serviced. Free professional car assessment; fixed quote before work starts. Only published price: Graphene Coating Bonnet Trial S$88.

- Address: 48 Toh Guan Road East, #02-124, Enterprise Hub, Singapore 608586
- Phone: +65 6635 6703

- Email: klar@motoserv.sg
- Hours: By appointment. Mon to Fri 9am to 8pm, Sat 9am to 2pm, closed Sun and PH

- [Paint Correction in Singapore](https://klardetails.com.sg/services/paint-correction/): Swirl marks, water spots, oxidation and light scratches corrected in enclosed bays. Free assessment, then a fixed quote before work starts.
